title: Anthony Weaver: Ravens DC job isn't a consolation prize

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Anthony Weaver: Ravens DC job isn't a consolation prize
sources.description: Anthony Weaver opened a Wednesday press conference by saying he saw a lot of familiar faces in the crowd at the Ravens' facility because it was only a couple of years ago that he was ending his first run as a member of Baltimore's coaching staff.
